status: frozen without inspecting any matched-base prediction or label outcome
completed_run_rule: The two fresh-process matched-base runs must have identical ordered case IDs, raw output bytes, strict predictions, and within-run repeat hashes. If they differ, retain and report both but do not evaluate the compilation-gain claim gate.
primary_metric: mean across rules of positive-class F1
secondary_metrics: per-rule positive-class F1 and exact accuracy
contrasts: PAW standard minus direct matched Qwen3-0.6B
PAW finetuned minus direct matched Qwen3-0.6B

uncertainty.method: paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap: resample rules with replacement, then complete contrast pairs within each sampled rule, using the identical draws for both systems

claim_gate: For each dataset and named compiler, call the matched compilation gain supported only when the lower 95% bound for the preregistered macro positive-class F1 delta is greater than zero.
multiplicity: Report all four dataset-by-compiler intervals. The estimation claim gate is interval-based and no omnibus null-hypothesis declaration is made.
latency: Report matched-base latency descriptively only; make no cross-system latency comparison unless hardware, runtime, quantization, call boundary, and batching are identical.
